name: Ergentics Foundations
install:
set -euo pipefail
found=
for d in /agent/repos/ergentics-foundations /workspace/repos/ergentics-foundations /workspace/ergentics-foundations; do
  if [ -f "$d/.cursor/cloud-agent-install.sh" ]; then
    found="$d/.cursor/cloud-agent-install.sh"
    break
  fi
done
if [ -z "$found" ]; then
  echo "cloud-agent-install.sh not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi
bash "$found"
